latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Video Creator.

- Instantly create polished YouTube videos using plain instructions—no editing skills required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB.
- Automatically cuts pauses, adds music, and exports 1080p MP4 ready for YouTube in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles authentication via free 7-day token with 100 credits for new users.
- Cloud GPU-based video rendering; status, credits, and export actions accessible via simple commands.
